{{Quote|The ion storms of Moorja have prevented the deployment of our standard battle-droid forces, but Neimoidian Gunnery Battalions, Gossam Commandos and Koorivar Fusiliers have consolidated to provide Moorja with cost-effective protective forces.|Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai, regarding the deployment of Koorivar Fusiliers to Moorja|<ref name="CIS">{{InsiderCite|76|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Koorivar Fusiliers''' were soldiers under the employment of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] that formed one of the organic components of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' combined military forces during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Their primary job was to guard Alliance facilities from Sabotage and 
Industrial espionage.<ref name="CWCG" />

[[File:Battle_of_Bomis_Korri_IV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Oro Dassyne/Legends|Oro Dassyne]], was appointed a general of the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] Fusiliers.]] The unit consisted primarily of [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]]. Members were distinguished by red head-armor, rib-armor, black metal boots, a hole for the horn on the forehead armor, and metal gloves. Their primary weapons were Koorivar-manufactured [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="GuidetoAlien">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
[[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|leader]] of the Corporate Alliance, took four or five of these as escorts. They were excellent warriors who only fought with their weapons when commanded.<ref name="GuidetoAlien" />
During the [[Clone Wars]], Argente appointed [[Oro Dassyne/Legends|Oro Dassyne]] as a general of the Fusiliers.<ref name="GuidetoAlien" />
General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] also sometimes used these troopers in specific battle strategies during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="GuidetoAlien" /> 

Koorivar Fusiliers were deployed to the Mid Rim world of Moorja during the Clone Wars, fighting alongside Neimoidian Gunnery Battalions and Gossam Commandos. Due to Moorja’s frequent ion storms, droid forces were unusable, prompting the Confederacy to rely on organic infantry. The Fusiliers operated in the planet’s agricultural zones, which also provided sustenance for the troops, reducing logistical costs.<ref name="CIS" /> They also participated in the battle of [[Bomis Koori IV]], under General Oro Dassyne.<ref name="GuidetoAlien" />

==Organization==
The command structure of the Koorivar Fusiliers was similar to that of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], though much smaller. The Fusiliers also relied heavily on artillery units during battles, each emplacement manned by two [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and a crew leader.<ref name="CWCG" />

*'''Regiment''': Commanded by a [[General/Legends|general]] and composed of three battalions plus support personnel.
*'''Battalion''': Commanded by a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], a battalion was composed of three companies, plus support personnel
*'''Company''': Commanded by a [[Captain/Legends|captain]], a company was composed of three platoons, plus support personnel.
*'''Platoon''': Commanded by a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], a platoon was composed of three squads.
*'''Squad''': Commanded by a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in charge of twelve Fusiliers.<ref name="CWCG" />
